subject: CBS only on CN data instead of using both CN and SNP data

messages.author: c6d34526b549c9cc
messages.subject: CBS only on CN data instead of using both CN and SNP data
parts:
Hi aroma group,
 I am wondering could we only do CBS on the CN data without SNP in it. 
In the affymetrix6  the input(raw data) contains both CN and
 SNP. How could I get the CBS result only with CN?

 Thanks.

 Best regards,
 Yu Song

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] CBS only on CN data instead of using both CN and SNP data
parts:
Hi,

there is no direct way to segment only non-polymorphic loci ("CN
probes")/exclude SNPs, but one approach would be to create a custom
UGP annotation data file where the genomic positions for all SNPs as
set to missing (=NA), and then explicitly use that UGP file when
segmenting the data.

/Henrik
